title: mcp/list_targets/v2
description: The result of the list_targets tool (F09-R9; D-28). v2 (mcpfix WA2, the owner's ruling of 2026-11-25): a page of summary rows by default, one target's every field with target_id, a projection with fields; full: true is targets/index.json exactly, as v1 answered always. Or an error result naming the source that did not answer (R10).

oneOf.description: The default: the index's rows in pages, each the summary fields, every field (target_id), or the fields asked for (mcpfix WA2).

read_at.description: The commit of main the graph was read at, or the branch name when the service could not learn its head (F05-T13).

index_schema.description: The schema the committed index declares (targets-index/v<n>); its row fields are what a row carries.

count.description: How many rows there are in all, across every page.

limit.description: The most rows this page could hold.

cursor.description: Where this page starts, as the call gave it; null for the first page.

next.description: The cursor of the page after this one; null on the last page.

fields.description: The fields each row carries: the summary (target_id, root, status, track, claimable, node_counts), target_id with the fields asked for, or null for every field (one target).

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
